name: Liquid pour transition

source.description: Genre convention: food and beverage advertising where a pour or splash fills the frame and becomes the next shot. Since 2026-11-26 also informed by one inspected user-supplied reference (a black liquid-edged surface around a cut to a dark section).

technique: A wavy liquid surface rises to cover the frame, then either drains away or becomes the next scene's background.

decomposition.timing: 1.0-1.6 s; ease in on the rise

provenance.observed: A hard cut to black holds 0.22 s, then the black retreats upward with a wavy liquid edge for about 0.1 s before the black verdict section cuts in (read from a 30 fps strip; medium confidence).

licensing_notes: Technique only. No specific artwork, footage, characters or compositions from any source are copied.
